mentions.name: LearnChess.ai
mentions.description: A chess learning app designed to include the fundamental features and polished UX the author found missing in other chess apps tried over recent years.
mentions.problem: Existing chess apps often lacked fundamental features and/or had terrible UX.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://www.learnchess.ai — The chess app I always wanted (I've tried a lot of apps in the last years but they always lacked some fundamental feature and/or had terrible UX).
